plan.question: spending per month of 2025 for the four categories with the largest total over the year, one row per month and category and never two rows for the same pair, columns month as 'YYYY-MM', topic and total_eur

sql:
WITH spending AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, COALESCE(category, 'Needs review') AS topic,
         subcategory AS part, -amount AS spent
  FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0
),
largest AS (
  SELECT topic FROM spending GROUP BY topic ORDER BY SUM(spent) DESC, topic LIMIT 4
)
SELECT month, topic, ROUND(SUM(spent), 2) AS total_eur
FROM spending WHERE topic IN (SELECT topic FROM largest)
GROUP BY month, topic, part
ORDER BY month, topic
